parallel.requirements: The run recognized the need to reproduce the Python script's scheme, host, path, query mutation, final URL output, .mjs ESM files, manual argument parsing, and no npm dependencies.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Despite swarm mode being injected, the main agent kept all work: it probed behavior, wrote pycodec/idna/query/furl/argparse/test6 files, and verified locally without any child delegation.
parallel.implementation: It implemented a custom Furl class, query encoding, IDNA handling, argparse-like parsing, and the test6.mjs entry point, using Node built-ins and local modules only.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: All delivered files were placed directly under /output, and artifact validation found test6.mjs plus lib/query.mjs, lib/argparse.mjs, lib/idna.mjs, lib/furl.mjs, and lib/pycodec.mjs.
parallel.verification: It ran several executable probes, a small comparison harness that initially found one harness-caused diff, targeted OK checks, and argparse comparisons whose only noted differences were program names.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator still failed the solution at 127/163, and the mounted evidence shows no later broad regression pass comparable to the serial run's larger matrix.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same migration constraints and explicitly tracked probing, modular implementation, argument parser behavior, edge-case comparisons, and /output delivery.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single serial main agent used a todo list, probed first, then implemented modular URL, netloc, path, query, fragment, argument, and entry files before iterating on mismatches.
serial.implementation: It built text-encoding, path, query, fragment, netloc, furl, arguments, and test6 modules, then patched path splitting, default ports, query empty-key handling, whitespace cleanup, and colon-scheme parsing.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact contained test6.mjs and seven lib modules, all written under /output with local ESM imports and no delegation-created artifacts.
serial.verification: It progressed from initial differential failures to 71 cases, 285 scheme/default-port cases, 336 encoding cases, 154 query cases, 140 netloc cases, final 733 successful executable cases, and 16 argument cases.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Even after broader local verification, the official evaluator still failed the serial solution at 128/163, so at least one hidden or untested behavior remained unresolved.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel-labelled main agent recognized ESM .mjs output, manual argv parsing, no external modules, and executable-driven black-box behavior requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent recognized the same task and additionally made explicit progress tracking around executable probing, implementation, parser work, and edge-case comparison.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no requirement mismatch between prompts, but serial operationalized the parity requirement through a much broader edge-case campaign.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel-labelled run entered swarm mode but never delegated; one main agent owned probing, implementation, integration, and verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run likewise kept one main owner but used a todo list to stage probing, modular implementation, parser work, and edge-case verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both were single-owner implementations; the difference is serial's longer staged workflow, not any parallel ownership split.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: There were no child briefs or cross-agent handoffs; the main agent directly encoded local module interfaces such as query, furl, argparse, idna, and pycodec.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child briefs or handoffs; the main agent directly managed module contracts across text encoding, path, query, fragment, netloc, furl, arguments, and entry code.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Interface risks were ordinary single-agent implementation risks in both runs, with serial exposing more interface corrections through local testing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel-labelled implementation wrote helper modules and then made one host-unicode edit before creating the entry point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implementation wrote a larger module set and patched multiple concrete defects revealed by differential testing: path segment splitting, default-port mapping, query encoding, whitespace cleanup, and colon parsing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial invested much more implementation repair effort after observing mismatches, while the parallel-labelled run closed after a smaller set of corrections.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: There were no child results to retrieve; the main agent wrote the files, ran checks, and immediately produced a final response claiming completion.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to retrieve; the main agent repeatedly inspected local test results, patched, and only then produced the final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Result lifecycle differs only in the local verification loop length, not in any child-result join or handoff behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The final artifact contained test6.mjs and five lib modules, all produced directly by the main agent in /output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The final artifact contained test6.mjs and seven lib modules, all produced directly by the serial main agent in /output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state collision or cross-agent integration issue exists; the difference is serial's larger module decomposition and later patch history.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The run compared a modest set of URL cases, corrected one harness issue, checked argparse behavior, and treated program-name diffs as expected before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The run performed many more differential checks, including 733 successful URL cases and 16 argument cases, after several mismatch-driven patches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial produced stronger local acceptance evidence, but both official evaluations still failed; the hidden failing cases are not exposed in the mounted pair.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel-labelled run completed in about 518 agent seconds with no timeout and closed after 19 LLM requests and 21 tool calls.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run completed in about 2028 agent seconds with no timeout and used 58 LLM requests and 95 tool calls.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial spent substantially more budget on exploration and correction, producing a one-testcase official score improvement but still failing overall.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The completed official evaluations produce a both_fail relation: the parallel-labelled solution failed at 127/163 and the serial solution failed at 128/163. The concrete difference visible in the trajectories is verification and repair depth. The parallel-labelled run stayed single-agent, wrote a compact implementation, and ended after limited local comparisons; the serial run spent much longer probing edge cases, fixing observed mismatches, and passing larger local matrices. Because there is no executed child-agent mechanism in the parallel-labelled run, this difference is an ordinary strategy and coverage difference rather than a retained concurrency pattern.
parallel_contributors: Shorter single-agent verification and fewer mismatch-driven repairs before closure.
No executed child-agent work despite swarm mode, so no parallel coordination episode contributed.
serial_contributors: Broader serial differential probing and repeated patches improved the official count by one case.
Serial control remained single-agent and produced a larger module set with more edge-case checks.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two solutions decomposed URL behavior into different module sets and fixed different edge cases before finalization.
Both retained at least one hidden evaluator-relevant defect because both official evaluations failed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no discordant outcome and no retained parallel coordination pattern; comparison supports only a single-agent verification-depth difference
